resources.string: App data included in ADB or cloud backups, allowing sensitive data extraction without root. (Coming soon)
backup_rules.xml excludes all sensitive files and databases from cloud backup.
App data included in Google cloud backup by default. Credentials extractable from any signed-in device.
data_extraction_rules.xml disables cloud and device transfer for sensitive files.
Session tokens and credentials migrate uncontrolled during Google\u2019s device-to-device transfer.
android:allowBackup="false" in Manifest. ADB backup command returns empty archive.
Sensitive DB exported via `adb backup` — extractable on any laptop without root.
Database encrypted with SQLCipher before backup. Backup file is unreadable without the Keystore-bound key.
Plaintext database included in backup — anyone with the backup file can open it directly in SQLite Browser.
